seo.description: Apply for high-paying RN jobs in Canada. Get travel, housing, and licensing support for registered nurse roles in hospitals, LTCs, clinics, and remote communities.

hero.title: Flexible RN Contracts from Coast to Coast
hero.subtitle: We place registered nurses in rewarding travel and full-time roles with full support.

blocks.text: We welcome both experienced RNs and new graduates ready to launch their careers
Apply for RN Opportunities in any of this province
Benefits of Working With Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html: Competitive bilingual pay rates. Travel, housing, and per diem coverage. Licensing support across provinces. Roles matched to your language skills. 24/7 recruiter access and onboarding help. Over 1,100 placements completed in 2024.

items.question: Do I need experience to apply?
items.answer: We hire both experienced RNs and new graduates. Certain placements may require a minimum level of experience.

items.question: How do travel RN jobs work?
items.answer: You accept short-term contracts in different provinces, with travel, housing, and licensing assistance provided.

items.question: Can I request specific locations or units?
items.answer: Yes. Your recruiter will work with your preferences and specialty.

items.question: Do you offer permanent RN roles?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to travel assignments, we offer permanent and temp-to-perm RN roles.

items.question: Do you offer bilingual RN placements?
items.answer: Absolutely! French-English bilingual nurses are in high demand.

blocks.text: Ready to Find Your Next RN Job?

blocks.html: We respond within 1 business day to qualified applicants.

Goodwill Staffing connects registered nurses with high-demand roles across Canada. From acute care and long-term care to public health and telehealth, our RN placements include full travel, housing, licensing help, and recruiter support.

blocks.text: Apply Now to Find a Travel Nursing Role That Fits

blocks.html: Let’s turn your skills into impact. Whether you're ready for your first contract or your fifteenth, we're here to support your journey. We respond to all qualified applicants within 1 business day.
